title: xDomain
tagline: Check out #xDomain made at #ETHGlobalParis! A historical cross-domain arbitrage visualization tool powered by odos.xyz/arbitrage. Handy for researchers studying cross-domain market inefficiencies: https://github.com/0xsamgreen/xDomain
description:
xDomain, developed for the ETHGlobal Paris 2023 hackathon, is a real-time and historical visualization tool for cross-chain arbitrage opportunities. It is built using the historical data collected by odos.xyz/arbitrage focuses on Uniswap V2 and its clones on Ethereum and various Layer 2 solutions.

xDomain allows users to understand high-level statistics about historical cross-domain arbitrage quickly. Statistics provided include:
* Total arbitrage detected over a specified time window
* Most common tokens that are involved in arbitrage opportunities
* The length of time that opportunities usually persist

The xDomain tool is a valuable resource for researchers seeking to quantify the market impact of cross-domain market inefficiencies. Additionally, it is the first time such data is publicly available, to the best of our knowledge.
how_its_made: Data is collected and provided by odos.xyz/arbitrage. (This data was collected over a span of many months, previous to the start of ETHGlobal Paris.) We then process the data to provide summary statistics. An API is provided for plotting or analytics use cases. The application has an intuitive front-end built with Node.js.
